fullText.simplified:
第6章、一件事，两种说法

    由于史元死了，王家兄弟就被抓到了大牢，情况很严重。
    看到王大说不清楚是怎么回事，王二就自己站出来说：“包大人，我们没杀史元。我们只想抓他来见您，请相信我们！”
    包公看了三个人一眼，又问：“但是史元已经死了，是谁杀的呢？”
    王三哭得手都在发抖，他说：“我、我们不知道，那时候他拿出了刀，我们都很害怕……”
    王大心里痛苦极了，朝着自己的脖子指了指，说：“史元用刀对着我的脖子，是我弟弟们挡住他，我才活了下来。”
    王二、王三也给包公看他们手上流着血、发着肿的伤口。
    王三插了一句：“您看到过那把刀吧？您应该知道，那把刀非常漂亮，非常贵，根本不是我们买得起的……”
    包公点点头，说：“我知道了。看来这刀，果然不是你们的。”
    三兄弟连连说是。
    包公看了他们一眼，皱着眉说：“你们的话我明白了，但你们知道史元的下人是怎么说的吗？”
    三兄弟呆呆地说“不知道”。
    包公看着他们，很久才说：“他们说，是你们先抓住了史元，然后从史元身上抢走了刀，然后杀了史元。”
    三兄弟都不敢相信自己的耳朵。
    王三飞快地说：“他们在骗人！”
    王大、王二也连连摇头，说着：“不是这样的！不是这样的！”
    王大着急地说：“包大人，请相信我们！那一天，路边有很多人都看到了！”
    王二点点头，说：“包大人，不如把他们都给叫来，他们都知道我们的话是对的！”
    包公就让人把这些路人也叫了上来，包子店的老板也在里面。但奇怪的是，不管王家三兄弟怎么问，这些人就是不愿意说，眼睛也不敢朝他们看。
    “我……我那天没看清楚，有人挡着……”第一个人说。
    “天太黑了，我们都没看清。”第二个人也说。
    “我看到你们和史元一起，后来、后来我害怕所以回家了……”第三个人低下头说。
    包公看到了，他明白了什么。但他还没来得及追问，一个穿着又贵又漂亮衣服的男人走了进来，对包公说：“包大人，我是史家的管家。这案子不是已经结束了吗？史元的爷爷、奶奶都哭了好几天了，公主也很不高兴。包大人，您可不能放过坏人啊！”
    包公看着这个管家，慢慢地说：“请放心，我不会放过坏人，但也不会抓错好人。”
    管家一动不动地看着那几个路人，笑着对他们说：“既然包大人要查，那你们就好好说清楚。要是说错了话，我可帮不了你们。”
    路人们听了管家的话，有的缩着脖子发抖，有的忍不住跪下了，对管家说：“我们不敢！”
    这件事越来越乱了。
fullText.traditional:
第6章、一件事，兩種說法

    由於史元死了，王家兄弟就被抓到了大牢，情況很嚴重。
    看到王大說不清楚是怎麼回事，王二就自己站出來說：“包大人，我們沒殺史元。我們只想抓他來見您，請相信我們！”
    包公看了三個人一眼，又問：“但是史元已經死了，是誰殺的呢？”
    王三哭得手都在發抖，他說：“我、我們不知道，那時候他拿出了刀，我們都很害怕……”
    王大心裡痛苦極了，朝著自己的脖子指了指，說：“史元用刀對著我的脖子，是我弟弟們擋住他，我才活了下來。”
    王二、王三也給包公看他們手上流著血、發著腫的傷口。
    王三插了一句：“您看到過那把刀吧？您應該知道，那把刀非常漂亮，非常貴，根本不是我們買得起的……”
    包公點點頭，說：“我知道了。看來這刀，果然不是你們的。”
    三兄弟連連說是。
    包公看了他們一眼，皺著眉說：“你們的話我明白了，但你們知道史元的下人是怎麼說的嗎？”
    三兄弟呆呆地說“不知道”。
    包公看著他們，很久才說：“他們說，是你們先抓住了史元，然後從史元身上搶走了刀，然後殺了史元。”
    三兄弟都不敢相信自己的耳朵。
    王三飛快地說：“他們在騙人！”
    王大、王二也連連搖頭，說著：“不是這樣的！不是這樣的！”
    王大著急地說：“包大人，請相信我們！那一天，路邊有很多人都看到了！”
    王二點點頭，說：“包大人，不如把他們都給叫來，他們都知道我們的話是對的！”
    包公就讓人把這些路人也叫了上來，包子店的老闆也在裡面。但奇怪的是，不管王家三兄弟怎麼問，這些人就是不願意說，眼睛也不敢朝他們看。
    “我……我那天沒看清楚，有人擋著……”第一個人說。
    “天太黑了，我們都沒看清。”第二個人也說。
    “我看到你們和史元一起，後來、後來我害怕所以回家了……”第三個人低下頭說。
    包公看到了，他明白了什麼。但他還沒來得及追問，一個穿著又貴又漂亮衣服的男人走了進來，對包公說：“包大人，我是史家的管家。這案子不是已經結束了嗎？史元的爺爺、奶奶都哭了好幾天了，公主也很不高興。包大人，您可不能放過壞人啊！”
    包公看著這個管家，慢慢地說：“請放心，我不會放過壞人，但也不會抓錯好人。”
    管家一動不動地看著那幾個路人，笑著對他們說：“既然包大人要查，那你們就好好說清楚。要是說錯了話，我可幫不了你們。”
    路人們聽了管家的話，有的縮著脖子發抖，有的忍不住跪下了，對管家說：“我們不敢！”
    這件事越來越亂了。

sentences.english: Lord Bao, you can’t let the bad guys go!”

sentences.simplified: 包公看着这个管家，慢慢地说：
sentences.traditional: 包公看著這個管家，慢慢地說：
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng kàn zhe zhè ge guǎn jiā màn man de shuō
sentences.english: Lord Bao looked at this butler and said slowly,

sentences.simplified: “请放心，我不会放过坏人，但也不会抓错好人。”
sentences.traditional: “請放心，我不會放過壞人，但也不會抓錯好人。”
sentences.pinyin: qǐng fàng xīn wǒ bú huì fàng guò huài rén dàn yě bú huì zhuā cuò hǎo rén
sentences.english: “Please rest assured that I will not let the bad guys go, but neither will I wrongly arrest the good guys.”

sentences.simplified: 管家一动不动地看着那几个路人，
sentences.traditional: 管家一動不動地看著那幾個路人，
sentences.pinyin: guǎn jiā yí dòng bú dòng de kàn zhe nà jǐ ge lù rén
sentences.english: The butler looked at the passersby without moving a single muscle.

sentences.simplified: 笑着对他们说：“既然包大人要查，那你们就好好说清楚。
sentences.traditional: 笑著對他們說：“既然包大人要查，那你們就好好說清楚。
sentences.pinyin: xiào zhe duì tā men shuō jì rán bāo dà ren yào chá nà nǐ men jiù hǎo hǎo shuō qīng chu
sentences.english: He smiled and said to them, “Since Lord Bao wants to investigate, then you should all make things clear.

sentences.simplified: 要是说错了话，我可帮不了你们。”
sentences.traditional: 要是說錯了話，我可幫不了你們。”
sentences.pinyin: yào shi shuō cuò le huà wǒ kě bāng bù liǎo nǐ men
sentences.english: If you say the wrong thing, I definitely won’t be able to help you.”

sentences.simplified: 路人们听了管家的话，有的缩着脖子发抖，
sentences.traditional: 路人們聽了管家的話，有的縮著脖子發抖，
sentences.pinyin: lù rén men tīng le guǎn jiā de huà yǒu de suō zhe bó zi fā dǒu
sentences.english: After hearing the butler’s words, some drew away, trembling.

sentences.simplified: 有的忍不住跪下了，对管家说：“我们不敢！”
sentences.traditional: 有的忍不住跪下了，對管家說：“我們不敢！”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rěn bú zhù guì xià le duì guǎn jiā shuō wǒ men bù gǎn
sentences.english: Some couldn’t help but kneel down, saying to the butler, “We wouldn’t dare!”

sentences.simplified: 这件事越来越乱了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事越來越亂了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì yuè lái yuè luàn le
sentences.english: This matter was getting more and more tangled.

sentence_translations: Chapter 6: One Matter, Two Explanations
Because Shi Yuan died, the Wang brothers were put in jail. The situation was very serious.
Seeing that Wang Da could not clearly explain what had happened, ..
.. Wang Er put himself forward and said, “Lord Bao, we did not kill Shi Yuan.
We only wanted to capture him in order to bring him to see you. Please believe us!”
Lord Bao looked at the three people and said, “But Shi Yuan is dead. Who killed him?”
Wang San was crying so much that he was shaking.
He said, “We, we don’t know. At that time, he took out a sword, and we were all very scared …”
Wang Da felt great pain in his heart.
He pointed to his neck and said, “Shi Yuan pointed his sword at my neck, and I survived only because my younger brothers blocked him.”
Wang Er and Wang San also showed Lord Bao the bleeding and swelling wounds on their hands.
Wang San interjected, “Have you seen that sword before?
You should know that that sword is very beautiful and very expensive. It is not at all something that we could afford …”
Lord Bao nodded and said, “Now I know. It seems that this sword really is not yours.”
The three brothers repeatedly said yes.
Lord Bao took a look at them, frowned, and said, “I now understand what you’re saying, but do you know what Shi Yuan’s servants are saying?”
The three brothers said blankly, “We don’t know”.
Lord Bao looked at them, and after a long time, said, ..
.. ”They said that it was you three who caught Shi Yuan, snatched the sword from him, and then killed him.”
The three brothers could not believe their ears.
Wang San said very quickly, “They’re lying!”
Wang Da and Wang Er also nodded repeatedly, saying, “It wasn’t like this! It wasn’t like this!”
Wang Da said anxiously, “Lord Bao, please believe us! That day, there were many people on the side of the road who saw!”
Wang Er nodded and said, “Lord Bao, why don’t we call them all over. They all know that we’re right!”
Lord Bao had people bring all the passersby over. The owner of the steamed bun store was also among them.
But the strange thing was that no matter how the three Wang brothers asked, ..
.. these people were not willing to speak, nor did they dare look at them.
“I … I didn’t see clearly that day. Someone was in the way …” said the first person.
“It was too dark. None of us saw clearly,” said the second person.
“I saw that three were with Shi Yuan, and then … and then I went home because I was scared …” said the third person.
Lord Bao saw this and understood something.
But before he had time to examine this closely, a man dressed in beautiful and expensive clothing walked in.
He said to Lord Bao, “Lord Bao, I am the butler of the Shi family. Hasn’t this case been closed already?
Shi Yuan’s grandfather and grandmother have cried for many days, and the princess is also very unhappy.
Lord Bao, you can’t let the bad guys go!”
Lord Bao looked at this butler and said slowly,
“Please rest assured that I will not let the bad guys go, but neither will I wrongly arrest the good guys.”
The butler looked at the passersby without moving a single muscle.
He smiled and said to them, “Since Lord Bao wants to investigate, then you should all make things clear.
If you say the wrong thing, I definitely won’t be able to help you.”
After hearing the butler’s words, some drew away, trembling.
Some couldn’t help but kneel down, saying to the butler, “We wouldn’t dare!”
This matter was getting more and more tangled.
